decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and supporting documents and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development: - drawing number (add reference number)dated (date on the plans) - documents entitled (document title) dated (date on the document)

Prior to the first use of the Street Hub hereby approved, the existing BT payphone shown on drawing no. WAF.14.1100 P1 shall be permanently removed from the site. Any redundant above-ground fixtures arising from its removal shall also be removed and the affected area of footway shall be made good using materials and finishes matching the adjoining footway.Reason: To ensure that the development is undertaken as a replacement of the existing telecommunications infrastructure, to prevent the retention of unnecessary street clutter, to maintain safe and convenient pedestrian movement and to preserve the character and appearance of the Walthamstow St James Conservation Area, in accordance with Policies 53, 61 and 72 of the adopted Local Plan.

The digital display screens hereby approved shall be installed, commissioned and thereafter operated and maintained in accordance with the lighting control measures contained within the submitted Street Hub Product Statement, Version 2.0 dated September 2024, and the submitted Institution of Lighting Professionals Professional Lighting Guide 05.The digital display screens shall:a. display static images only, with each image remaining unchanged for a minimum period of 10 seconds;b. not display any moving, animated, flashing, scrolling, intermittent or full-motion images or video content;c. use instantaneous transitions between images without fading, sequencing or other visual transition effects;d. not exceed a maximum luminance of 600 cd/m² between sunset and sunrise; ande. incorporate automatic ambient-light sensors and dimming controls to ensure that screen luminance responds appropriately to prevailing lighting conditions.The automatic dimming controls shall be maintained in effective working order for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To prevent excessive brightness, glare, light spill and visual distraction, to safeguard the living conditions of nearby residential occupiers, to maintain public and highway safety and to preserve the character and appearance of the Walthamstow St James Conservation Area, in accordance with Policies 50, 53, 57, 59, 61 and 72 of the adopted Local Plan.
description: Removal of the existing BT phone box and installation of a global street hub (BT Pay Phone Outside 63 High Street, Walthamstow, London, E17 7AD).
